title: LLMObs plugin manifest (v1alpha1)
description: llmobs-plugin.yaml — the contract for how the kernel runs a plugin. Additive-only at this maturity. Tier-2 (frontend-only) plugins declare a frontend surface and request only data capabilities.

capabilities.description: Requested data primitives. Capabilities are nouns about data, never verbs about features. `ingest` lets a compat plugin write telemetry through its own cold-path endpoint (ADR-0003); the plugin ingestion endpoint itself is Tier-3 work.

permissions.description: Fine-grained data scopes the plugin requests (e.g. traces:read.metadata). Enforced by the Query API permission intersection.

frontend.description: Module Federation frontend surface (Tier-2). SHA-pinned at install.

remoteName.description: MF remote container name (matches the plugin's MF config 'name').

exposedModule.description: The exposed module to load, e.g. './plugin'.

entry.description: The MF remote entry filename produced by the build, e.g. 'remoteEntry.js'.

nav.description: Nav items the shell renders; each mounts the surface at a route.

settingsSchema.description: Optional path to a JSON Schema for the plugin's settings (rendered by SchemaForm; future arc).

store.description: Plugin-owned structured collections (the `store` primitive, ADR-0023/R1+R4). The kernel provisions a plugin-namespaced schema per plugin and one table per collection during the plugin's starting phase. Filter/order is over declared indexed fields only — no aggregations, no joins. `store` holds plugin DOMAIN entities; it MUST NOT duplicate telemetry (the canonical model is the source of truth for spans/traces/scores).

indexed.description: Filterable/orderable. json fields cannot be indexed.

jobs.description: Scheduled/on-demand jobs (the `jobs` primitive, H6b). The kernel invokes the plugin backend endpoint on schedule with a system identity assertion scoped to the plugin's own grant. A missing schedule => on-demand only.

path.description: Plugin backend endpoint the kernel POSTs to.

backend.description: Tier-3 backend service (external-URL executor, ADR-0023/R2). The operator runs the service; the kernel handshakes, supervises, and proxies /api/plugins/{id}/* to it. The kernel never gets a DB connection string — the plugin uses the SDK primitives.

url.description: Base URL the kernel reaches the plugin backend at, e.g. http://langfuse-compat:8080. Operator-configurable at install.

healthPath.description: Path of the plugin health endpoint (GET), e.g. /plugin/v1/health.

infoPath.description: Path of the handshake info endpoint (GET). Defaults to /plugin/v1/info.

watermarkBudget.description: Max functional-watermark staleness before the plugin is considered degraded (e.g. '30s'). Absent => watermark not used for the running/degraded decision.
